citations.claim: At step 2071 the controlled body sits exactly on its waypoint with near-zero speed; next step it is non-finite.
First violating step: body 4 position is non-finite (NaN).

counterfactual.change: Set controller.enabled true->false; all else identical. Passing run shows the controller law causes the NaN.

explanation: Controlled body 4 converges exactly onto its waypoint by step 2071 (position equals waypoint 6.8283,8.7618, speed ~1.6e-13, force ~3e-12). On the next step its state becomes NaN. Likely cause: the waypoint-seeking law normalizes the vector to the waypoint (or velocity error) dividing by distance ~0, producing 0/0=NaN which then poisons position, velocity and energy. Disabling the controller removes the failure.
vision_note: In steps 2069-2071 a red body hovers near the top while blue bodies rest on the floor. At step 2072 the red body vanishes leaving only a green waypoint cross at its position, the blue bodies teleport into a stacked pile on the left wall, and all later tiles are blank.
